Normal Types are usually light-hearted and easy- going people.
Like everyone else, they have their flaws and insecurities,
But perhaps uniquely, they're able to accept themselves and others in spite of their flaws, and are experts at making the best of situations both good and bad.
Fire Types are all about passion and ambition.
They're earnest and active. When they want something, they go for it all-out.
There's no better go-getter, but Fire Types risk pushing themselves too hard and burning out.
They're great at getting things done, but when it happens, it's sure to be on their schedule and no one else's.
Water Types are masters of going with the flow.
Balancing cool rationality with a deep understanding of their own and others' emotions, they're adept at understanding all sides of a conflict.
As extremely adaptable individuals, they can adjust to any sort of scenario-- even if it would be unhealthy-- and make it their own.
Electric Types light up a room!
Energetic, forthright and cheerful, they bring an unrivaled spirit to any conversation.
Their impulsiveness can often lead to things getting out of hand, but their positive nature lends itself to smoothing over conflicts and making a lot of fun memories along the way.
Grass Types tend to put others before themselves.
They go out of their way to help and soothe others, and are great contributors to making the world a more positive, peaceful place.
Despite the fact that their habitual benevolence wins plenty of friends, they can also sometimes be insecure and prone to having doubts.
In reality though, Grass Types are often much more cherished than they will ever realize.
Ice Types are some of the most charming and unique people,
But seldom do they realize it.
Many Ice Types hide behind a veil of aloofness, often hiding how much they truly worry or care about others.
Their cool distance serves both to entice others, suggesting an air of mystery and refinement,
But at the same time, in hiding how much they truly care, they risk pushing others away and missing out on welcome opportunities.
Fighting Types are models of determination.
Understanding that it is not the 100th strike that cracks the stone, but the 99 that came before it, no one is better able to set their mind to a task and stick to it.
Working with a tireless fervor that many others can only dream of, Fighting Types are sure to achieve whatever they pursue with enough time and patience.
Poison Types are prone to resigning themselves to circumstances they don't truly wish to be in.
They value others above themselves, and may give up on themselves too easily.
In spite of these things, they often don't realize that they make for some of the best and closest friends that can be found.
Without ever realizing their own importance, they serve vital roles in the lives of those around them, all the while slowly building themselves up.
Ground Types are pragmatic and stubborn.
Unphased by traditional notions of what's "right" or "best", Ground Types view life and society from the outside looking in.
They prefer to remain with their ideals regardless of the consequences, which tends to work out well given how firmly rooted in results and effectiveness they often are.
Flying Types are free-spirited dreamers!
Always looking for bigger, better, more exciting things, they aren't necessarily bound to what they """should""" be doing.
Sometimes this gets them in trouble, but some might say Flying Types have an uncanny ability to just narrowly avoid whatever dire consequences would come of their mischief.
Moreover, they have a ton of fun doing whatever it is they do, and always get the last laugh.
Psychic Types are intelligent and analytical.
They value creativity, thoughtfulness and understanding.
They often see the pattern and reasons behind events and circumstances rather than the circumstances themselves, and thus thrive individually and socially.
While they can sometimes miss the forest for the trees and be extraordinarily unique in their own rites, they seem to seldom mind this.
Bug Types are intellectual and reclusive.
They tend to be introverted, preferring books, games, or the internet to the company of real people.
The result is a surprisngly unique and refined perspective on many subjects, even if they are often unsure of how best to share it.
The best among Bug Types hollow out their own place in the world with like-minded individuals who share their passions and interests in the comforts of mutual respect and curiosity.
Rock Types are unshakably loyal companions.
Great at listening and following directions, those who earn the respect and service of a Rock Type are especially lucky.
Rock Types always stick up for their friends, faithfully serve their communities, and dutifully manage their families.
Despite this, they sometimes prefer to be left to their own devices, or might struggle to tear themselves away from negative people,
But the burden of loyalty, while not an easy one to bear, is an invaluable and often overlooked cornerstone of society and our friendships.
While Ghost Types may appear intimidating or mean, at the end of the day, they're just practicing their sense of humor.
Often a darker humor, and sometimes at the expense of others, it is seldom truly ill-meaning.

Rather, cavalcades of jokes and pranks are both the sword and shield of a Ghost Type, serving to break the ice and earn favor with others, while also protecting their true, vulnerable selves from scrutiny.
Truly getting to know a Ghost Type beneath the surface can be a challenge in its own right, but should someone be let in, there's a bright and magnetic soul to be found.
Dragon Types aren't weighed down by "common sense", rules, or expectations.
As free-thinkers who read between the lines, they have a wealth of things to offer the world and those around them.
They can be intense and particular, but only because they quickly come to understand in wisdom what many others cannot.
Dragon Types often struggle to make close friends, but when they do attach to people, it is never lightly, always forming an unshakable bond sure to alter each of their lives forevermore.
Dark Types are the most reserved.
They tend to be in conflict with both others around them and themselves, and often prefer to keep their distance as a result.
Nevertheless, Dark Types have many hidden strengths, varying from person to person.
Often able to do things others aren't, or with a perspective no one else would have, they can make for invaluable allies.
Still, it is rare that they ever let people too close to their hearts...
Steel Types don't let much get to them.
Steadfast, even-keel, and direct, they know what they want, how they want it, and one way or another, they'll get it.
While they can be prone to cynicism or nihilism, they often make reliable comrades and effective colleagues.
Fairy Types are optimistic and inspiring!
They often strive to be a source of light and goodness in their communities, making for fast friends and strong leaders.
Their much-needed whimsy and creativity can often fill an emptiness where the dusts of routine and melancholy begin to settle.
